title: Lightly Cured Canadian Tripe Skillet
description: A sour and springy solo dinner dish featuring tripe, shio cure, and no onion or garlic, perfect for a Canadian meal. This recipe is easy to make and requires minimal ingredients.

ingredients.name: tripe
ingredients.notes: beef tripe, cleaned and cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: Rinse the tripe under cold water and pat it dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, mix together the shio cure, lemon juice, and olive oil.
Add the tripe to the bowl and toss to coat with the shio cure mixture.
Let the tripe marinate for 30 minutes.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the tripe to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until it is lightly browned.
Season the tripe with salt and black pepper.
Garnish with chopped parsley and lemon zest.
Serve the tripe hot, straight from the skillet.
